answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded gale. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the mirror of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the onyx behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 61c4a.
